email.subject: Quick fixes for Iron Tide Fitness's site
email.body:
Hi Jack,

I checked Iron Tide Fitness's website. Two things are likely costing you members: it's not set up for mobile, so people checking hours or booking from their phone (most visitors) run into a clunky page and leave. There are also no reviews showing, which matters when someone's comparing gyms in Harbor Falls before picking one. The page title also just reads "Home" instead of your gym's name, which hurts how you turn up in search.

I fix this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what I'd change. Worth a quick look?

Alex
